test_function_signatures: test that pybind11 bound functions expose correct Python signatures with typed arguments and defaults
test_named_arguments: test calling pybind11 functions with positional and keyword arguments including default values
test_mixed_args_and_kwargs: test pybind11 functions that accept mixed positional args, *args, **kwargs, and keyword-only arguments
test_keyword_only_args: test pybind11 functions that enforce keyword-only arguments after the kw_only annotation
test_positional_only_args: test pybind11 functions that enforce positional-only arguments before the positional-only separator
